title: ProposalRequest
description: What Lane A's propose flow submits. Used as the body of POST /api/forecast (dry run, no writes) and POST /api/rollouts (creates a draft rollout). The same shape for both so the forecast the merchant approved is the forecast stored with the rollout.

name.description: Merchant's label. Lane B generates one when omitted.

variant_gids.description: Ineligible variants (gift cards, subscription products, non-active) may be submitted; Lane B returns them as excluded rather than erroring (R22).

stages.description: Omit for the default 25% / 50% / 100% plan with 3, 3, 4 day holds. A single-variant selection collapses to a time canary regardless of what is sent here.

fraction.description: Cumulative share of the selection live at this stage. Must be non-decreasing and the last must be 1.

guardrails.description: Omit on POST /api/forecast. Required on POST /api/rollouts — no rollout starts without a conscious guardrail decision.

scheduled_start_at.description: R14. null or omitted = start when the merchant hits go.

notify_emails.description: Defaults to the shop's stored notification addresses.
